newsitem.title: MEXICO: Tropical storm Blanca seen picking up off Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Tropical storm Blanca seen picking up off Mexico.

text.p: Tropical Storm Blanca is expected to gather more steam late Wednesday after pounding the Guerrero state coastline in southern Mexico with winds and high waves.
Mexico's National Weather Service said the storm was moving in a north-westerly direction and would strengthen gradually.
"Extreme caution is recommended for maritime navigation because of rains, sea swell and storm winds within a 250 km radius from the centre of the storm," it said.

By 0100 (0600 GMT) on Thursday the storm is expected to be located some 285 miles (460 kms) west south-west of Manzanillo, in Mexico's western Colima state, and some 360 miles (580 km) south south-east of Los Cabos, in Baja de California state.

Ships can expect winds up to 75 km an hour, gusts of up to 95 km an hour. Winds of 63 km an hour and four metre swells will be felt up to 55 km from the storm's centre, it added. ((--Caroline Brothers, Mexico City newsroom +525 728 7905))
